review.posthog_relevance: ClickHouse authentication error message localization and user diagnostics
review.reason: The chunk P1.F1.H1 introduces a new constant `_INVALID_CREDENTIALS` and assigns it to the `'authentication failed'` key and the `'code: 516'` entry in the ClickHouseErrors dictionary. This changes the error message returned by the ClickHouse connector when authentication fails, replacing a generic string with a user-friendly constant. This could help PostHog users diagnose ClickDB/
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the definition of the `_translate_error` implementation or the ClickHouseErrors dictionary, so it cannot be independently verified that the new message is actually returned. The score is assigned based on the observed addition of the constant and its assignment, not on verified end-to-end behavior.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the definition of the ClickHouseErrors dictionary or the _translate_error implementation, so the reviewer cannot independently verify that the new error message is actually returned by the translation function. observations.posthog_connection: This could improve the user-facing error message when ClickHouse authentication fails, replacing the generic 'Invalid user or password' with a more descriptive message. This could help users diagnose credential issues more effectively.
